name: Senator Verdow's office in the Parliament
about: The small office inside the Parliament where Verdow receives Gladias in chapter 17 and the team in chapter 32. The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Forward, then right turn, then forward, then third door on the left.
facts.fact: The same office in chapters 17 and 32, by the same directions.

facts.quote: A robot slid into the room.
Verdow tapped a few buttons on the robot's screen
a map of the world that was printed on the side of the office wall
facts.fact: A world map is printed on the office wall.

descriptor: a small, warm senator's office inside a round stone parliament hall, with honey wood paneling against a curved pale stone wall, a low table between deep armchairs, a tall window onto green trees, a large wordless map of unfamiliar continents and seas printed across one wall, and a slim serving robot with a screen face waiting at the door
